reading: Ed Sheeran's US concerts in Massachusetts were cancelled this weekend.
This cancellation was due to severe weather warnings across the New England area.
He had been scheduled to perform two shows at Gillette Stadium near Boston.
A statement from the concert promoter confirmed the difficult decision to cancel the events.
The decision was made with the safety of fans and staff as the top priority.
Weather warnings for high winds were active until the early hours of Sunday.
Ticketholders who purchased tickets through Ticketmaster will be automatically refunded.
The tour had previously been in the news for a different controversy.
This involved dropping support act Macklemore after he made pro-Palestinian comments on stage.
Stadium owners had lobbied for Macklemore's removal from the shows.
